name: Big Green Pocket Park

layers.essential_history: [[r:Big Green is a pocket park. Sources give its opening year as 1997 or 1998.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:Deeper history for this stop is still to be written.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: you find a torn inventory page. It lists the estate's furniture, including one blue dispatch chest, last seen moved to the steward's store.]]

puzzle.title: The igloo
puzzle.intro: [[r:Find the information board at Big Green. Use the board, not the structure, as it may change.]]
puzzle.question: [[r:What living material was used to make the igloo described on the board?]]
hints: [[r:Read the board about the play structure.]]
[[r:It is a tree or shrub material.]]
[[r:It also gives the name to a tree you can see on the walk.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[r:If the board is hard to read, ask for the answer.]]

evidence: [[c:An inventory lists a blue dispatch chest, last moved to the steward's store.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Directions to be supplied after the recce. Next stop: Dexter Way.]]
